Grab your Net Gun and head into the wild! 🌲 

Your mission is simple:

🔫 Shoot animals with your net gun to catch them.
🚚 Bring them back to your enclosure, where NPCs will admire your collection.
💵 Earn money every time visitors check out your animals!

❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!

data.name: Throw Food For Animals
data.description:
🍖 Welcome to Throw Food for Animals!

How to Play:
🥕 Throw food as far as you can
🦁 Attract and collect animals from different areas
💰 Earn money from your animals
🍔 Buy better food to attract rarer animals
💪 Train on pull-up stands to gain Throw Power
🌍 Reach new areas with stronger and rarer animals
